title: NEAR Protocol and Nigerian Geography
text:
NEAR is a blockchain platform [round 4]. On 7 November 2026, its mainnet runs protocol version 88 [round 2]. This same protocol version 88 is active on 12 November 2026 [round 32]. Developers use specific libraries to interact with the network. The near-sdk is a Rust library for contracts [round 5]. Its newest release is in major version 5 [round 5]. This release requires Rust 1.95 or newer [round 6]. The library is released under the MIT or Apache 2.0 licence, at the user's choice [round 7].

For JavaScript developers, near-api-js is the relevant library [round 8]. It allows talking to NEAR through its RPC API [round 10]. The newest release is in major version 7 [round 8]. This version needs Node.js 22 or newer [round 9]. These tools facilitate interaction with the platform's infrastructure.

In Nigeria, Abuja is the capital [round 11]. Lagos is the largest city in the country [round 12]. Lagos served as a former capital until Abuja replaced it in 1991 [round 13]. Geographically, Lagos lies about 6.46 degrees north of the equator [round 14]. It is located about 3.39 degrees east of Greenwich [round 15]. Abuja lies about 9.06 degrees north of the equator [round 16].
